import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205;
    static final int M = N * N;
    
    static int[] prev = new int[M];
    static int[] mark = new int[N];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] from = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int ec = 0;
    static int[][] a = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] b = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] red = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] block = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dred = new int[N];
    static int[] seen = new int[N];
    static Pair[] q = new Pair[N];
    
    static int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
    }
    
    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        from[ec] = u; to[ec] = v; cap[ec] = uv; prev[ec] = head[u]; head[u] = ec++;
        from[ec] = v; to[ec] = u; cap[ec] = vu; prev[ec] = head[v]; head[v] = ec++;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
        if (v == sink)
            return flow;
        if (mark[v]++ != 0)
            return 0;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = prev[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = to[e];
                int x = dfs(u, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[e]));
                if (x > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= x;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += x;
                    return x;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int max_flow(int source, int sink) {
        int res = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(mark, 0);
            int add = dfs(source, sink, (int)2e9);
            res += add;
            if (add == 0)
                break;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int dt = sc.nextInt();
        
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], (int)1e9);
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                String foo = sc.next();
                if (foo.equals("Y"))
                    block[x][y] = 1;
                else if (foo.equals("Z"))
                    red[x][y] = 1;
                else
                    a[x][y] = Integer.parseInt(foo);
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                String foo = sc.next();
                if (!foo.equals("Y") && !foo.equals("Z")) {
                    b[x][y] = Integer.parseInt(foo);
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && block[i][j] == 0 && red[i][j] == 0) {
                            dis[x * n + y][i * n + j] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int m = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j]) {
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int h = 0, t = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dred, (int)1e9);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j] == 1) {
                    q[t++] = new Pair(i, j);
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (h != t) {
            Pair cur = q[h++];
            int x = cur.first, y = cur.second;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && block[i][j] == 0 && red[i][j] == 0 && dred[i * n + j] > (int)1e9) {
                    dred[i * n + j] = dred[x * n + y] + 1;
                    q[t++] = new Pair(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sink = N - 1, source = N - 2;
        for (int cur = 0; cur < m; cur++) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            h = 0;
            t = 0;
            int sx = cur / n, sy = cur % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] == 1 || red[sx][sy] == 1)
                continue;
            q[t++] = new Pair(sx, sy);
            seen[cur] = 1;
            while (h != t) {
                int x = q[h].first, y = q[h++].second;
                if (dis[cur][x * n + y] <= dt) {
                    add_edge(cur << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                if (dis[cur][x * n + y] == dred[x * n + y])
                    continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d], id = i * n + j;
                    if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && block[i][j] == 0 && red[i][j] == 0 && 
                        dis[cur][id] <= dred[id] && dis[cur][id] <= dt && dis[cur][id] > dis[cur][x * n + y] && seen[id] == 0) {
                        q[t++] = new Pair(i, j);
                        seen[id] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            add_edge(source, i << 1, a[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            add_edge(i << 1 | 1, sink, b[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow(source, sink));
    }
}
